description: List Japanese government tender notices for one or more prefectures without needing a keyword — the way to browse what a given prefecture published recently. Sourced from the 官公需情報ポータルサイト (Kankoju public procurement portal, Japan SME Agency). Accepts a prefecture name ("Osaka", "大阪府") or JIS X0401 code ("27"), optionally narrowed by category, announcement date range and keyword.

category.description: One of goods | works | services (or 物品 | 工事 | 役務, or 1 | 2 | 3).

full_text.description: Return the full announcement text instead of a preview. Default false.

prefecture.description: Prefecture name ("Tokyo", "東京都") or JIS X0401 code ("13"). Comma-separate for several. Codes are zero-padded for you — a bare "1" returns nothing upstream.

query.description: Optional keyword to narrow within the prefecture.

name: japan_tenders_by_prefecture
title: Japan Tenders By Prefecture
